summary: United Microelectronics Corp filed a Form 6-K on July 30, 2026, containing two routine announcements. First, it set the conversion price at NT$146.0 per share for its 1st domestic unsecured convertible corporate bond, based on a base price of NT$121.7 and a 119.97% conversion premium rate. Second, its subsidiary Fortune Venture Capital disposed of 870,000 Centera Photonics shares at NT$375.45 each, realizing a gain of NT$248,883,331. These are ordinary capital markets and asset disposal disclosures, not special-situation events. No strategic shift, tender, or restructuring is indicated. What to watch: potential dilution from bond conversion and further stake sales.
